API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIPAC FilesPac Resource Add Pac Version
Pac Resource Add Pac Version
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/pacFiles/:pacId/version/:clonedPacVersion

Adds a new PAC file version by branching an existing version based on the specified ID. To learn more, see Using Custom PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
pacId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the ID of the PAC file for which a new version needs to be created

clonedPacVersion
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the PAC file version that needs to be branched

QUERY PARAMETERS
deleteVersion
int32

Currently, only 10 versions of a PAC file are supported. If this limit is reached and if you are adding a new version using the POST /pacFiles/{pacId}/version/{clonedPacVersion} endpoint, the deleteVersion parameter can be used to specify the PAC file version that must be replaced with the new version created using this request. However, if the limit is reached and if a version is not specified using this parameter, the version with the least number is automatically replaced. If the limit is not reached, this parameter is ignored.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for the PAC file

name
string

The name of the PAC file

description
string

The description of the PAC file

domain
string

The domain of your organization to which the PAC file applies

pacUrl
string

The URL location of the PAC file that is auto-generated when the PAC file is added for the first time.

Note: This value is not required in POST and PUT requests and the value is ignored if present.

pacContent
string

The content of the PAC file. .

editable
boolean

Indicates whether the PAC file is editable

Note: The Zscaler service provides default PAC files, and admins with sufficient permissions and scope can additionally create and manage their own custom PAC files. and . This field is read-only.

pacSubURL
string

Obfuscated domain name of the organization to which this PAC file applies

pacUrlObfuscated
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the PAC file URL is obfuscated. If this value is true, the obfuscated URL is returned in the pacSubURL field.

pacVerificationStatus
string

Indicates the verification status of the PAC file and if any errors are identified in the syntax

Possible values: [VERIFY_NOERR, VERIFY_ERR, NOVERIFY]

pacVersionStatus
string

Indicates the status of a specific version of a PAC file as whether it is deployed, staged for deployment, or is marked as the last known good version.

Possible values: [DEPLOYED, STAGE, LKG]

pacVersion
int32

The version number of the PAC file

pacCommitMessage
string

The commit message entered while saving the PAC file version as indicated by the pacVersion field

totalHits
int64

The number of times the PAC file was used during the last 30 days

lastModificationTime
int32

The timestamp when the PAC file was last modified. This value is represented in Unix time.

lastModifiedBy
object
createTime
int32

The timestamp when the PAC file was created. This value is represented in Unix time.
